The sum of all six ratios can be found from the product of the two given sums.

Expanding the product:

$$(a+b+c)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c\right) = 3 + \left(\frac ab+\frac ba+\frac bc+\frac cb+\frac ca+\frac ac\right).$$

So the required sum is

$$(a+b+c)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c\right) - 3 = 26 \cdot 28 - 3 = 728 - 3 = 725.$$

ANSWER: 725
